quests.title: Welcome to the Twilight Forest!
quests.desc:
The &9Twilight Forest&r is a mod that adds the Twilight Forest dimension to the game. This dimension is filled with brand new items, biomes, mobs and bosses!

To create the portal to get to the &9Twilight Forest&r, make a 2x2 hole in the ground and fill it with water. Surround the edges of the hole with flowers, and throw a Diamond into the water.

Assuming you did it correctly, Thor will give you a sign and the portal will activate.

{image:atm:textures/questpics/gettingstarted/twilight_portal.png width:100 height:100 align:center fit:true}

quests.title: The Silence of the Forest
quests.desc: In the &9Twilight Forest&r, there are a bunch of new creatures to discover.\n\nOne of the worst of these creatures is the Cicada. I suggest killing this for this, but killing any Twilight Forest mob will work.

quests.title: The Final Boss
quests.desc:
...is not implemented.

Instead, head to the giant castle in the Final Plateau and grab some door blocks!

There is a Kobold that spawns in as a "placeholder" but you will get nothing from killing it.

quests.title: Fancy Noms
quests.desc: There are a lot of different foods you can make from the &9Twilight Forest&r!\n\nTry them all!

quests.title: Raven Feathers
quests.desc: It's easy to get lost in the &9Twilight Forest&r. In your travels, you'll run into &5Obsidian Pillars&r.\n\nThese pillars will have &8Ravens&r around them. Kill them and they'll drop their feathers, which you can use to create a map for the &9Twilight Forest&r!

quests.title: The Real Final Boss
quests.desc: Within the &9Twilight Forest&r, there are loot chests that can give you rare saplings.\n\nCollect them all!

quests.title: Evening The Scales
quests.desc:
The first boss you'll have to kill on your adventure in the &9Twilight Forest&r can be found within the Courtyard.

The &2Naga&r is a green serpent made up of multiple segments, as you deal damage to it, it's segments will disappear.

Killing the &2Naga&r will drop some nice items and grant you entry to the home of the next boss, the Lich.

quests.title: Bring out your Dead
quests.desc:
The &eLich Tower&r is home to the &eLich&r! The fight has 3 phases:

Phase 1: The &eLich&r surrounds himself in shields, and attacks you with &5Ender Pearls&r that shoot out like Ghast fireballs. Reflect them back to the &eLich&r to break his shields! As his shields break, he'll send out duplicates to distract you.

Phase 2: The &eLich&r switches scepters to summon Zombies to help him in the fight. With his defenses down, you will be able to melee him!

Phase 3: Once all of the charges are spent on his Scepter, he will switch to a &eGolden Sword&r and go berserk. Kill him fast!

quests.title: Mighty Meef Stroganoff
quests.desc: In the depths of the Labyrinth Swamp is a giant &cMinoshroom&r.\n\nOnce defeated, it'll drop &eMeef Stroganoff&r. To unlock the next area, you must eat it.

quests.title: Hydra Slayer
quests.desc:
The &9Hydra&r is the infamous multi-headed beast from Greek Mythology.

Ranged attacks aren't as effective, meaning you'll need to get up close and personal.

Once defeated, you'll be able to find the next boss in the &2Dark Forest&r.

quests.title: The Dark Forest
quests.desc:
Inside the &2Dark Forest&r, you'll find a structure that leads underground.

To enter, you'll need to place one of the boss trophies you've acquired on the nearby pedestal, don't worry about which one you place, you can pick it back up.

On the 3rd layer, you'll find the Knight Phantoms. Defeat these to unlock the next boss.

quests.title: Tears of Fire
quests.desc:
Within the &2Dark Forest&r, you'll find the &8Dark Tower&r.

To enter, look for the reappearing blocks at the base. Find your way through the maze all the way to the final floor to fight the &cUr-Ghast&r.

The &cUr-Ghast&r is recommended to kill with a ranged weapon. There are 4 Ghast traps found on the boss floor, which can be used to damage the &cUr-Ghast&r.

These are charged with &cGhastling&r kills, then activating with Redstone. You don't have to use them, but they can prove useful.

quests.title: To the Snow Biomes!
quests.desc:
After defeating the &cUr-Ghast&r, you'll unlock the Snowy Forest biomes.

There are many creatures to fight, but to continue your progression, you'll need to kill the Alpha Yeti.

You can find the Alpha Yeti in a massive Yeti cave. Defeat it to move on.

quests.title: Clear Skies
quests.desc:
Defeating the Alpha Yeti unlocks the &9Glacier&r biome. Here, you'll find cute little Penguins and the &3Snow Queen&r.

At the top of the &bAurora Palace&r, the &3Snow Queen&r will summon Ice crystals to protect herself.

She'll also slam &3Ice&r down that can destroy the floor and deal massive damage.

You'll only be able to hit her top half, as she's protected by &3Ice&r.

After defeating the &3Snow Queen&r, you'll unlock access to the &2Highlands&r.

quests.title: Lamp of Cinders
quests.desc: With a &8Giant's Pickaxe&r, you'll want to head back to Troll Caves to find &5Giant Obsidian&r.\n\nUse the &8Giant's Pickaxe&r to break it, and you'll find some loot. Acquire the &6Lamp of Cinders&r to continue.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.sub: The giants look like me, but are nothing LIKE me
quests.desc:
With Magic Beans and Uberous Soil, you'll want to look for a large cloud in the highland biomes.

Plant the magic beans in the soil to grow a beanstalk all the way up. Here, you'll find the Giants.

You'll need to kill the Miner Giant and get their pickaxe to continue on.

quests.title: Naga Scale Armor
quests.desc: From the scales of the &2Naga&r, you can craft some armor.\n\nThe armor isn't very strong, but it looks nice.

quests.title: Scepter of Twilight
quests.desc: Do you want to be able to shoot Ender blasts like the &eLich&r? If so, the &9Scepter of Twilight&r is the scepter for you!.\n\nTo recharge, combine it with an &5Ender Pearl&r in a crafting grid.

quests.title: Scepter of Life Draining
quests.desc: Using the &cScepter of Life Draining&r, you can drain the life of your enemies!\n\nTo recharge the scepter, combine it with &cFermented Spider Eyes&r in a crafting grid.

quests.title: Zombie Scepter
quests.desc: The &2Zombie Scepter&r exists because who doesn't want to summon their own &2Zombies&r?\n\nTo recharge, combine with &cRotten Flesh&r in a crafting grid.

quests.title: Scepter of Fortification
quests.desc: The &6Scepter of Fortification&r summons shields around you for protection.\n\nTo recharge, combine with &6Golden Apples&r in a crafting grid.

quests.title: To the Swamps!
quests.desc:
It's time to go to the &2Swamps&r! In the &2Swamps&r, you'll find an odd-looking hill with an entrance on top. This is the &cMinoshroom Labyrinth&r!

Inside, you'll fight several new enemies that can drop &eMaze Map Focus&r. This is needed to make a &eMaze Map&r.

This is a special map that will map your way around the &cMinoshroom Labyrinth&r. Minimaps have no power here.

You can also find several loot rooms with special loot for the Maze!

quests.title: Magic Map
quests.desc: This map is a must have for the &9Twilight Forest&r.\n\nUsing a &eBlank Magic Map&r will give you a map that shows icons for nearby bosses and structures.

quests.title: Steeleaf Armor
quests.desc: This is slightly stronger than &2Naga&r armor, and comes fully enchanted.\n\nYou can make these by finding &2Steeleaf&r within the &9Twilight Forest&r.

quests.title: Ironwood Armor
quests.desc: &6Ironwood Armor&r can be crafted using &6Ironwood&r and comes automatically enchanted.

quests.title: Fiery Armor
quests.desc: The &2Hyrda&r drops &cFiery Blood&r that can be used to craft &cFiery Armor&r.\n\nWhen wearing the full set, enemies that attack you will be set on fire for 10 seconds.

quests.title: Phantom Armor
quests.desc: &2Phantom Armor&r has a chance of being found in &2Knight Phantom&r chests.

quests.title: Knightmetal Armor
quests.desc: Knightmetal Armor&r can be crafted with Knightmetal Ingots and has a chance of being found in &2Knight Phantom&r chests.

quests.title: Ramification
quests.desc: Find the &cQ&6u&ee&2s&3t&9i&5n&cg &6R&ea&2m&r, for it bestows wealth to those who give it &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w &6W&eo&2o&3l&r (16 colors).\n\nHint: There's a Dispenser above your head in the ruins where the Ram is. It might prove useful.

quests.title: Charm of Life I
quests.desc: The &cCharm of Life I&r is a single-use item that will prevent death. Instead of dying, the charm will be consumed and you'll be given health regen for a short period of time.\n\nThese can be found in loot chests.

quests.title: Charm of Life II
quests.desc: Just like the &cCharm of Life I&r, the &eCharm of Life II&r is consumed to prevent your death. When consumed, you'll regen all of your health and be given Regen IV, Resistance, and Fire Resistance for 30 seconds.\n\nThese can be crafted with 4 &cCharms of Life I&r.

quests.title: Charm of Keeping I
quests.desc: The &6Charm of Keeping I&r will prevent you from losing the items in your main hand and off-hand, as well as any armor you're wearing when you die.

quests.title: Charm of Keeping II
quests.desc: The &fCharm of Keeping II&r works the same as the &6Charm of Keeping I&r but stops you from losing the stuff in your hotbar when you die too.

quests.title: Charm of Keeping III
quests.desc: The &eCharm of Keeping III&r works the same as the other Charms of Keeping, but stops you from losing all of the stuff in your inventory.

quests.title: Yeti Armor
quests.desc: Yeti Armor can be crafted with Alpha Yeti Fur.

quests.title: Arctic Armor
quests.desc: Small Yetis and Winter Wolves drop Arctic Fur, which can be used to make &6Arctic Armor&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Mazebreaker is a special pickaxe that is rarely found in Labyrinths.\n\nThis pickaxe will take 1 damage when breaking Maze Walls, instead of the 16 damage for all other pickaxes!

quests.title: Tri-Bow
quests.desc: The &dTri-Bow&r is dropped from the &3Snow Queen&r, it can shoot 3 Arrows at the same time, while only using 1.

quests.title: Seeker Bow
quests.desc: The &aSeeker Bow&r is dropped from the &3Snow Queen&r, it can shoot Arrows that home in on your targets. No more missing!

quests.title: Ice Bow
quests.desc: The &bIce bow&r can be found randomly in loot chests, it will inflict Slowness III for 10 seconds on hit.

quests.title: Ender Bow
quests.desc: The &3Ender Bow&r is found rarely in the &bAurora Palace&r.\n\nWhen an enemy is hit with an arrow from this bow, you will swap places with them. Be careful shooting things out of the sky!

quests.title: Ore Magnet
quests.desc: The &cOre Magnet&r that can pull up anything with Ore in name, except Coal.\n\nThis can be found in &2Hollow Hill&r chests.

quests.title: Glass Sword
quests.desc:
The &7Glass Sword&r deals 40 hearts of damage, but only has 1 durability.

You can make it indestructible if you want to use it.

These are rarely found in loot chests in the &bAurora Palace&r.

quests.title: Ice Sword
quests.desc: Found in the &bAurora Palace&r, the &3Ice Sword&r will give enemies &bFrosted&r for 10 seconds when damaged.

quests.title: Moonworm Queen
quests.desc: The &6Moonworm Queen&r is like a torch launcher. It launches &eMoonworms&r at the targeted block, which light up the block similar to a torch.\n\nThese can be found in some &2Hollow Hill&r and &eLich Tower&r loot chests.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Do you want to make the &aOverworld&r feel more like the &9Twilight Forest&r?

You can use this powder on animals in the Overworld to convert them into their &9Twilight Forest&r variants.

You can find this in dungeon chests in the &9Twilight Forest&r.

quests.title: Magic Map Focus
quests.desc: Combining a &8Raven Feather&r with &eTorchberries&r and &6Glowstone&r will give you a &eMagic Map Focus&r.

quests.title: Fiery Tools
quests.desc:
Using the &cFiery Blood&r from the Hydra, you can make a couple of tools.

The Fiery Sword comes with Fire Aspect II.

The Fiery Pickaxe comes with auto-smelt.

quests.title: Minotaur Axe
quests.desc: The &bDiamond Minotaur Axe&r is dropped by the &cMinoshroom&r. It deals more damage when the user is sprinting.

quests.title: Reappearing Vanishing Blocks
quests.desc: &cReappearing Blocks&r are like really cool doors. Once right-clicked, they'll disappear for a short time.\n\n&cVanishing Blocks&r will disappear when right-clicked, but they don't come back.

quests.title: Carmanite Builders Reactors
quests.desc: &cCarminite Builders&r, when powered with a Redstone signal, will generate temporary blocks in the direction the signal came from.\n\nThe &cCarminite Reactor&r will convert nearby Obsidian and Netherack into &eFalse Gold&r and &3False Diamond&r. After a short period of time, this will suck up nearby blocks and explode, creating &cCarminite Ghastlings&r around it.

quests.title: Visiting the Giants
quests.desc: Once you've unlocked the &2Highland&r biome, head over and find some Trolls to kill.\n\nThey can drop some &9Magic Beans&r. You'll also find chests that give you Uberus Soil, which is needed to grow the Magi Beans.

quests.title: Every Thorn has its Rose
quests.desc: Using the &6Lamp of Cinders&r, you are able to break the Thorns in the Thornland Biome.\n\nGather some &cThorn Roses&r to continue on to the &2Final Plateau&r.
